mentions.name: Ottex
mentions.description: Ottex is a native macOS app with a tiny footprint offering a BYOK (bring-your-own-key) alternative to Wispr Flow and Raycast AI shortcuts. Users add their OpenRouter API key to get global voice-to-text transcription powered by Gemini 2.5 Flash, plus AI shortcuts like "Fix Grammar" and "Translate to {Language}" using any OpenRouter model, making AI dictation features cost pennies instead of monthly subscription fees.
mentions.problem: The author was spending around €35/month (€420 a year) on two apps for AI features that cost just pennies to run.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on https://ottex.ai/ - BYOK alternative to Wispr Flow and Raycast AI shortcuts.

mentions.name: Ottex
mentions.description: Native macOS app that solves repetitive micro tasks on a computer: transcribes voice to text (useful for explaining things to Claude Code), with upcoming features to select text and instantly check grammar, improve writing, change tone, and translate between languages. Built around cheap small language models to replace multiple subscription utilities for small repetitive tasks.
mentions.problem: Existing subscription apps (Grammarly, Raycast, Wisperflow) charge $10-20/month for embarrassingly simple tasks that can be done with cheap small language models, so the author built one app specialized in small repetitive tasks on the computer.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building https://ottex.ai - a native MacOS app to solve repetitive micro tasks on a computer.

- Transcribe voice to text (especially useful when you need to explain something to Claude code )

- (soon) select text to instantly Check grammar / Improve writing / change tone of text

- (soon) select text to Translate between languages
